title: DWARF risk work package
description: A Milestone-1 planning and grouping record that connects candidate risks to evidence and remaining work; it is not a forensic runtime bundle.

id.description: Stable work-package identifier and URL segment.

label.description: Human-readable grouping of related security surfaces.

runnable.description: Whether the legacy CLI has an implemented read-only evidence action for this package.

status.description: Current planning/evidence status; this does not promote or accept a risk.

candidate_ids.description: Exact candidate-risk identifiers grouped by the package.

evidence_paths.description: Repository-relative evidence references; availability is checked separately.

blockers.description: Evidence, instrumentation, or policy gaps that prevent closure or promotion.

read_only_actions.description: Completed observations or explicitly allowed read-only follow-up actions.

runtime_profile.description: Optional exact profile identifier used by the legacy evidence action.

runtime_root.description: Optional remote runtime root used by the legacy evidence action.
